{{Top|leg}}
The '''Intelligentsia''' were the third highest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]], below The [[Bureaucracy (Algara II)|Bureaucracy]]. They were the [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who among the most intelligent on the planet, serving as [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]], [[Professor/Legends|professors]], [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], and [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]].
